# Annexe

```{r rootdir, include=FALSE}
# Child documents are knitted from the package folder (system.file("rmd")):
# without this, the files they write (Figures/...) would go there, which is
# read-only when the package is installed in a library owned by another user.
if (is.null(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"))) knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = getwd())
```

```{r loadingqsifneeded}

if(exists("path_to_process_fisheries_data_list")){
  
  process_fisheries_data_list <- CWP.dataset::cwp_read_object(path_to_process_fisheries_data_list)
  
}

```


```{r reviewimpact}

df2 <- process_fisheries_data_list$full_df %>% dplyr::select(Step, Explanation, Functions)

df3 <- flextable(df2) %>% width("Explanation",width = 4)
df3 <- set_caption(df3, caption ="Review of all the impact and purpose of every the treatment done")

```


```{r reviewimpactknitting, results='asis'}

knit_print(df3)

```
